svg.text: → every slot 10% toward its blue in OKLab a/b (gray 3%)
Prussian blue dark, whiteprint light. Follows the accent's hue.
The ramp turns by the accent's OK hue minus blue's, holding each key's luminance; a tint band scales its chroma by where it lands.
tint band: center 250°, flat 100°, fall 60°, floor 0.4
chroma kept (of authored), by the OK hue the ground lands on; dots are the accents
no tint band: full tint at every hue
